impact.heading: Our Impact
impact.subheading: We are building systems to measure and report our work transparently.
impact.note: Once verified data exists, we will share metrics such as:

metrics.label: People trained
metrics.description: Individuals who completed skill development programmes

metrics.label: Students supported
metrics.description: Children and youth receiving educational support

metrics.label: Employment opportunities facilitated
metrics.description: Job placements and livelihood connections made

metrics.label: Women reached
metrics.description: Women participating in education and empowerment programmes

metrics.label: Meals/services delivered
metrics.description: Humanitarian support provided to communities in need

metrics.label: Community programmes
metrics.description: Active programmes across different focus areas

metrics.label: Villages/areas reached
metrics.description: Geographic spread of our community work

metrics.label: Volunteers engaged
metrics.description: People contributing time and skills to our mission

metrics.label: Corporate projects implemented
metrics.description: Partnership projects with companies and institutions

reportingStandards: Every number has a reporting period
Every number has a clear definition
We never publish invented impact statistics
